name: Pedro Manoel Nabuco
bio: Pedro Manoel Nabuco is a Brazilian actor, filmmaker, and playwright. He has appeared in Brazilian streaming productions for Globoplay and HBO, gaining recognition for his role in "Desperate Lies" (2023), released on Netflix. In addition, he has written for independent theater and film projects.
